description: Curated MCP server configurations recommended for workforce-cc projects. Add an entry to a project's .claude/settings.local.json (mcpServers section) to install. Patterns of categorisation and env-var placeholders follow the affaan-m/everything-claude-code mcp-servers.json shape.

servers.summary: Read GitHub repos, issues, PRs, and Actions runs.
use_when: Engineer needs to read issue/PR descriptions or recent commit history.

servers.summary: Query a PostgreSQL database read-only. Useful when the architect or stack-selector needs to inspect a real schema.
use_when: Validating a data-model proposal against an existing DB.
Gap-analyst checking that documented schemas match reality.

servers.summary: Read filesystems outside the project directory — e.g. shared design assets, platform docs, neighbour repos.
use_when: Architecture decisions reference a shared design system or sibling repo.
Avoid: when project files are sufficient — keep blast radius small.

servers.summary: Persistent KV-style memory across sessions. Conductor can record long-running run state.
use_when: Multi-day projects where session restart loses orchestration state.
Avoid: short single-session runs — telemetry.jsonl + .workforce/runs/ already suffice.

servers.summary: Structured multi-step reasoning aid for the conductor and alignment-guard.
use_when: Complex multi-engineer dispatches where the conductor needs to reason through dependencies.
Alignment guard cross-check work that has many findings to score.

servers.summary: Fetch a URL and parse to text/markdown. Lighter than full WebSearch.
use_when: Market-researcher needs to read a specific competitor page.
Architect wants to read upstream library docs.
